senses.gloss: मदृभाष्यव्याख्या name given to each of the explanatory glosses on the Mahaabhaasya written by grammarians prominent of whom were Purusottamadeva, Naaraayana Sesa, Visnu, Nilakantha and others whese fragmentary works exist in a manuscript form. महामिश्र name of a grammarian who wrote a commentary on Jinendrabuddhi's Nyaasa. The commentary is known by the name Vyaakaranaprakaasa.
